title: Generating metamers of human scene understanding

layout.note: A wide top row runs left to right from inputs to the UNet and loss; below it a large pale-cyan panel, tied to the UNet by a translucent wedge, shows one block as three parallel branches between input and output features.

lesson: To show where a new conditioning path joins a frozen backbone, draw the whole pipeline on top and open one block in a zoom panel, with parallel branches coloured per stream and a snowflake or flame on every module.
